facts.note: Watch read twenty minutes to nine when the temple struck nine at dinner; the uncle's scene about it is also stated.
Went up to the library and sat there alone; watch read twenty to ten when the temple struck ten.
Thump right above him in the atelier at 10:18 by his watch; then the repeater's ten slow deep notes (counted), doubled notes, then quick high ones (not counted).
Someone went quickly up past the library door at 10:15 by his watch, and quickly down at 10:21; he did not see who and the door was shut.
Aunt's piano was playing downstairs when the thump came.
Girard came into the library at 10:32 by his watch and they sat together until the temple struck eleven.

added.quote: Aunt Odile was at the piano downstairs.
added.why: Places Aunt Odile downstairs at the piano while Félix was in the library after dinner, before the thump, which the sheet does not give.
